Lists the projects published by the caller in any lifecycle state, oldest first, with the hours donated to each.
Hours donated add up the hours committed by Active and Completed donations.

get.summary: Searches the active projects (anonymous); other states are never returned.
get.description: Results are sorted by publication date, newest first, with the project id (descending) as tie-breaker.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of items per page (1 to 100, default 20).

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: Optional text (at most 100 characters); matches the project name, full name or description (case-insensitive, literal substring).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Optional exact programming language, for example `C#`.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Optional topic (case-insensitive); only projects with this topic are returned.

hours.description: The whole number of hours spent on the project.

githubReference.description: Optional evidence: an HTTPS link to github.com, for example a pull request or a commit.

AddContributionRequest.description: Represents a request to log time spent on a project.

projectId.description: The identifier of the project the time was logged on.

contributorId.description: The identifier of the contributor who logged the time.

contributorGitHubLogin.description: The GitHub login of the contributor at the time of logging.

contributorAvatarUrl.description: The avatar URL of the contributor at the time of logging.

githubReference.description: Optional link to a GitHub pull request or commit that evidences the work.

loggedAt.description: The moment the hours were logged.

ContributionResponse.description: Represents a time contribution logged on a project.

githubLogin.description: The GitHub login of the contributor.

avatarUrl.description: The avatar URL of the contributor.

role.description: The role of the contributor; absent when not set.

skills.description: The normalised skills of the contributor; empty when none were set.

hoursAvailable.description: The whole number of hours the contributor can donate; absent when not set.

donorOrganizationId.description: The identifier of the affiliated donor organization; absent when independent.

ContributorProfileResponse.description: Represents the profile of a contributor.

name.description: The name of the donor organization.

contactEmail.description: The contact email of the donor organization.

website.description: The website URL of the donor organization.

CreateDonorOrganizationRequest.description: Represents a request to create a donor organization.

projectId.description: The identifier of the project the hours are pledged to.

donorOrganizationId.description: The donor organization of the pledge; absent when pledged as an individual.

status.description: The lifecycle state: Pending, Active, Completed or Cancelled.

hoursLogged.description: The number of pledged hours that were logged on the project while the donation was active.

progressPercentage.description: The share of committed hours that is logged, in whole percent (0 to 100).

createdAt.description: The moment the pledge was made.

updatedAt.description: The moment the pledge last changed.

DonationResponse.description: Represents a donation pledge and its progress.

name.description: The name of the donor organization.

contactEmail.description: The contact email of the donor organization.

website.description: The website URL of the donor organization.

createdAt.description: When the donor organization was created.

updatedAt.description: When the donor organization was last updated.

hoursAvailable.description: Pledged hours of the organization's active donations that are not logged yet.

hoursSpent.description: Hours logged on all donations of the organization.

GetContributionsResponse.description: Represents the contributions logged on a project.

contributors.description: The affiliated contributors, ordered by GitHub login; empty when there are none.

GetDonorOrganizationContributorsResponse.description: Represents the contributors affiliated with a donor organization.

totalCount.description: The total count of donor organizations.

GetDonorOrganizationsResponse.description: Represents a paginated list of donor organizations.

projects.description: The list of projects for the current page.

totalCount.description: The total number of published projects.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

GetProjectsResponse.description: Represents a paginated list of published projects.

githubLogin.description: The GitHub login of the maintainer.

avatarUrl.description: The avatar URL of the maintainer.

MaintainerProfileResponse.description: Represents the profile of a maintainer, the owner of one or more projects.

hours.description: The whole number of hours pledged.

asIndividual.description: Pledge as an individual. Exclusive with string? PledgeDonationRequest.DonorOrganizationId.

donorOrganizationId.description: The donor organization the hours are pledged for. Exclusive with bool PledgeDonationRequest.AsIndividual.

PledgeDonationRequest.description: Represents a pledge of developer hours to a project. Exactly one donor must be given: an individual or a donor organization.

fullName.description: The full repository name including owner (e.g. owner/repo).

githubUrl.description: The URL to the GitHub repository.

createdAt.description: When the repository was created on GitHub.

updatedAt.description: When the repository was last updated on GitHub.

pushedAt.description: When the repository was last pushed to on GitHub.

fullName.description: The full repository name including owner (e.g. owner/repo).

githubUrl.description: The URL to the GitHub repository.

ProjectSummaryResponse.description: Represents a summary of a published project for list views.

RegisterProjectRequest.description: Represents a request to register a project.

examples: Please add a description of the project.
reason.description: The reason the changes are requested. Shown to the maintainer.

RequestProjectChangesRequest.description: Represents an administrator's request for changes to a project under review.

skills.description:
The skills of the contributor; each is trimmed, blank ones are dropped and duplicates (ignoring case) are merged.
Each skill has at most 100 characters.

hoursAvailable.description: The whole number of hours the contributor can donate.

donorOrganizationId.description: The identifier of the donor organization the contributor is affiliated with; the organization must exist.

name.description: The name of the donor organization.

contactEmail.description: The contact email of the donor organization.

website.description: The website URL of the donor organization.

UpdateDonorOrganizationRequest.description: Represents a request to update a donor organization.
